claim: About a week into most of the world being quarantined, there couldn't be a more important time to unleash your true power as a man

Resistance is something we battle in every aspect of life, all the time: in different forms within us, it stands in the way of becoming who we want to be, accomplishing what we want and feeling the way we want
One of resistance's greatest tools against us is fear
About a week into most of the world being quarantined, there's so much collective fear energy in the world. You may feel it or not, but it's out there
Fear and uncertainty are such a weapon for resistance, which makes us feel stuck, popping up as fear, doubt, pain, negative thought patterns
With most of the world quarantined, resistance is in a really strong position now: things have changed directly for so many people, and for us all in a lot of ways

Personally, if the quarantine lasted a week or two, maybe chilling to relax and recharge, as all these people say, would do, and that's good. But what if it lasts 18 months? We can't spend 18 months relaxing: we gotta keep progressing
name: Being on the journey

claim: Personally, even once things a little bit go back to normal after the quarantine, a major economic thing means things will take a while to get started again, and for people with businesses things have just changed
Having talked to so many people, and having really felt it personally: in the quarantine it's really easy right now to feel kind of stuck, physically in our homes for the most part, and mentally
It's good to recharge, definitely good to take time to be really still, but we also need to keep pushing forward
name: Being on the journey

section: The two ends of the spectrum
claim: The tools against resistance fall on one end or the other of a spectrum: getting really, really quiet and still, or getting really uncomfortable and working really hard

section: The two ends of the spectrum
claim: The ends of the spectrum, getting really, really quiet and still or getting really uncomfortable and working really hard, are where we gain the advantage against resistance

section: The two ends of the spectrum
claim: In the middle of the spectrum between getting really quiet and still and getting really uncomfortable and working really hard, we get lost in thought, feel stuck and don't get stuff done
Tool number one against resistance is a cold shower
Every human being is capable of taking a cold shower
Cold showers have so many physical benefits: the immune system benefits are "actually proven", a cold shower boosts your white blood cell count
If you're in good health right now, start cold showers; you don't want to necessarily start if you get sick in some way

More important than your body: a cold shower is like kicking resistance right in the nuts, saying "I will do hard things today", choosing what leads where you want to go even if it's not what feels good or what you want right now
If you've never taken a cold shower, you can start on warm and kind of transition to cold, but "I would really encourage you", sooner rather than later, over some number of days, to go straight cold
A straight cold shower won't be comfortable, but you can do uncomfortable, hard things, and the payoff in body, mind and spirit is really, really powerful
Faced with cold, you either kind of freak out, which you probably will a little if it's new, or go to a deeper place
There's really no in-between in a cold shower: you won't be worrying about the bills or the coronavirus in there
If you somehow can still be lost in thought and stress in a cold shower, you'll be the first person ever talked to who can. Maybe it's possible, but pretty much everything else goes away
A cold shower takes you into the really calm, quiet, powerful place below thought

Even if the calm, quiet place of a cold shower doesn't last a super long time, the effects last throughout your day: you set a precedent for yourself of how the day will go, doing the hard things, focused on the long term
On the other end of the spectrum of tools against resistance from getting uncomfortable, meditate

With most of the world quarantined, we all have time right now: absolutely no reason all of us cannot be meditating every day. We all got at least 10 minutes back, "no question", from driving around or to work
Finding the still, quiet place through meditation is again where we gain power: resistance and stress fade away and the real us comes out
Meditation is not instant
Starting to meditate can be really intimidating: there's an unknown of what we'll face when we get quiet and watch what's happening inside us, and you might face some hard things initially
If you push through the hard start of meditation, pretty quickly it becomes a place where resistance, stuckness, angst, anxiety and stress fade away
Download Headspace, if you have a phone

During the quarantine Headspace has a really, really awesome 10 day course called Navigating Change, usually part of the paid app, which is so worth it: built on Headspace's core structure, about the idea of change, really perfect right now
Start meditating with 10 minutes a day
Third tool against resistance: get uncomfortable, do hard stuff, because it's hard, for no other reason
To get uncomfortable and do hard stuff: getting uncomfortable outside in the cold, though a lot of us aren't super fortunate to be close to that, or grinding with a workout, which we all can do
Getting uncomfortable and doing hard stuff takes intensity: that's where we really gain against resistance
A suggestion for doing hard stuff: figure out how hard you can really go in a 60 to 90 second or two-minute period, combining bodyweight things, which we can all do
A shift of focus to bodyweight, since a lot of people connected with on social media don't have a ton of equipment at home, or any: "I think there's no reason we can't kick ass with bodyweight stuff"
A suggestion for doing hard stuff: combine push-ups and squats with your eyes closed, which has such a powerful effect
name: Exercising with eyes closed

claim: Combining push-ups and squats with your eyes closed, go back and forth, whatever your sets look like: three push-ups and five squats, great; 20 push-ups and 50 squats, great; push-ups on your knees, it doesn't matter
name: Exercising with eyes closed

claim: Combining push-ups and squats with your eyes closed, when you get burned on one, switch to the other and work as hard as you can
name: Exercising with eyes closed

claim: Combining push-ups and squats with your eyes closed will not take you a long time
name: Exercising with eyes closed

claim: Really soon in push-ups and squats with your eyes closed you'll be grinding and faced with a choice: give in to "this is hard", or push through (at some point you have to stop)
You can do more than you think, especially with your eyes closed
name: Exercising with eyes closed

claim: Keep going even when your body's telling you to stop with that burn, and you really gain ground against resistance

The ground gained against resistance carries into the rest of life: your work or business, how you're making things work financially right now, your relationships, how calm you are and how well you deal emotionally with all of this, with most of the world quarantined
A few simple things win the ground back against resistance

There are other ways, but everybody can do the three tools against resistance, a cold shower, meditation and hard work with eyes-closed push-ups and squats, daily: if you have access to water, can sit still and can move your body
Doing the three tools against resistance, a cold shower, meditation and eyes-closed push-ups and squats, daily right now: "do it with me"
If you've never done the three tools against resistance, a cold shower, meditation and eyes-closed push-ups and squats, you will feel the power
A cold shower, your Headspace, then eyes closed, wherever you are, squats and push-ups, every single day; whatever else you want to do is fine
A fourth tool against resistance: semen retention, really the ultimate power gaining back against resistance, the ultimate punching-through force to do what you want and get where you want
Plenty of episodes in the archives cover semen retention
With most of the world quarantined, now could not be a better time to start practicing semen retention
Fear is resistance's greatest tool, and both are strong right now, with most of the world quarantined
We cannot sit idly by, not knowing how long until whatever the new normal is
Resistance keeps us from accomplishing what we want and keeps us feeling kind of shittier than we have to: gain that ground back daily and you'll feel better, even if you already feel great
